verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly claim automatic tax calculation, filing, and multi-state/local tax compliance handling (gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-45, gusto-docs-37), which is exactly what the story asks for. However, a specific hands-on report describes Gusto issuing erroneous W-2c corrections that combined payments from two different tax IDs, resulting in payroll being double-reported to the IRS, with support unable to resolve it (gusto-comm-11) — a concrete documented failure of the automated tax-filing pipeline. Missing for 10: independent verification that tax filing/remittance works reliably at scale, and no vendor response/resolution to the cited filing error is evidenced.
